visual_action: A split-screen video. The top half shows Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez speaking at the Munich Security Conference (MSC). The view alternates between a close-up on her and a wider shot of the audience and stage. The bottom half shows a static clip of a blonde pageant contestant, Caitlin Upton, speaking into a microphone.

cast.name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
cast.evidence: She is shown speaking on the top half of the screen for the entire video. The post caption also names her ('AOC').

spoken_summary: The video first plays audio of Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez speaking hesitantly, with many pauses and filler words, saying, 'I think that this is a... a very long-standing... policy of the United States.' After approximately 26 seconds, the audio is replaced by a famous, nonsensical speech from pageant contestant Caitlin Upton, which includes lines like 'I personally believe that U.S. Americans are unable to do so because...' and referencing 'South Africa and the Iraq.' The juxtaposition implies a comparison between the two speakers' coherence.
audio_music: The first part of the video features only dialogue from AOC with ambient room noise. At approximately 26 seconds, when the audio switches to Caitlin Upton's voice, an upbeat, somewhat cheesy instrumental track begins and plays until the end. The music serves a comedic and mocking purpose.
editing_pacing: The video uses a split-screen format to juxtapose two different people. The editing is simple, with a few cuts in the top video panel, but its primary technique is the sharp audio cut from one speaker to another to create a comedic and mocking comparison.
cultural_references: The video heavily relies on the viral clip of Caitlin Upton, Miss Teen South Carolina 2007, giving a rambling and incoherent answer at the Miss Teen USA pageant. This is a well-known internet meme used to signify nonsensical public speaking.
central_claim: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez is as unintelligent and incoherent as Caitlin Upton in her infamous Miss Teen USA pageant answer.
intended_effect: To mock Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and portray her as unintelligent.
